CustomField.description: SFDC-366. Additional Units of Measure a rep may select for this product on a quote line, beyond the default held in QuantityUnitOfMeasure. The quote line picker shows QuantityUnitOfMeasure plus these values. Leave blank when the product only ever uses its default unit - a blank value means the quote line behaves exactly as it did before SFDC-366.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Extra units a rep can choose on a quote line. The product's own Quantity Unit Of Measure is always offered and does not need to be selected here.
CustomField.label: Allowed UoM
